method_notes.returns: simple period returns on adj_close (total-return proxy incl. distributions)
method_notes.desmoothing: Geltner AR(1): r_true_t = (r_obs_t - rho * r_obs_t-1) / (1 - rho), rho = lag-1 autocorrelation
method_notes.caveat: Yahoo adj_close approximates distribution reinvestment. Official fund TR calcs may differ modestly (flagged for CF2 cross-check vs fund fact sheets)
